summary: Episode 26: A spilled ink pot ruined the pages Tariq had copied all morning, and his anger flared. Salim steadied him with a reminder that true strength is mastering oneself when angry. Tariq breathed, let the anger go, and felt the quiet victory of restraint. He is learning patience and self-control. Noor still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
Tariq is learning patience and mastering his temper
The reading circle continues to grow
The traveler is gone, carrying the district's kindness into the world
